topic: Common enterprise AI myths, corrected with delivery experience

slides.hook: 4 AI myths your board still believes

slides.fact: AI removes repetitive load. Teams move to judgment, strategy and client work — output rises without cuts.
You need a starting point. Pilots surface data gaps faster than any audit — and fix them in weeks.

slides.myth: Enterprise AI takes years to pay off.
slides.fact: Scoped automation shows measurable ROI within the first quarter. Start narrow, prove it, expand.

slides.myth: Custom AI is only for tech giants.
slides.fact: Mid-market teams deploy custom agents in weeks now. The tooling matured — the advantage is in moving early.

slides.line: Which myth is running your roadmap?

caption:
Four beliefs we hear in every first meeting — and what delivery across 50+ builds says instead.

The expensive one is the third: waiting for perfect data while competitors run pilots.
